column8:
《Eternal Radiance》以經典日式動作RPG為藍圖，玩家將引領見習騎士麗斯蒂展開冒險旅途，證明自己的實力，成為一名真正的騎士。為追逐賊人而離鄉背井，橫跨大陸期間，她將揭發賊人行動背後的深刻陰謀......

特色

以角色為本的劇情 – 麗斯蒂與同伴法拉娜和露比將周遊大陸，認識世界，了解歷史，並揭發蠢蠢欲動的陰謀......

刺激的動態戰鬥 – 以刺激的動作戰鬥系統，挑戰各種不同的敵人。計劃戰鬥，施放大絕，消滅敵人！

美麗又神秘的世界 – 在這個過去被蒙在迷霧之中的奇妙世界，探索原野、城鎮和地下城等各種地型。

自訂成長 – 變化多端的廣大技能樹，讓你自訂麗斯蒂的戰鬥風格。

任務 – 除了主線劇情之外，各種支線任務和活動讓你可以更加深入探索《永恒光輝》世界和其中人物。認識背後故事，幫助身處困境的人們，並與你的夥伴一同跨越他們每個人的難關。

隊友互動 – 旅途期間，三名主要角色將逐漸成長改變，在令人忍俊不禁的互動之中，她們的羈絆將不斷加深。各種有趣對話，讓她們的友誼更添色彩。

附魔 – 使用魔法遺物進行附魔，強化裝備和技能。

あなたはアイミとしてプレイします。あなたの目的は邪悪な魔女に捉えられている母親のカテリーナを救うことです。

アイミはビデオゲームの歴史の中で最もユニークな能力を持っています。彼女は髪の毛を使って枝をつかんでスイングすることができます。 操作はシンプルです：3つのボタンとジョイスティック。 それぞれ壮大な障害物コースで、スイングとジャンプのスキルを習得してください。

ステージレベルはさまざまなアイテムと敵で作られ、各レベルで俊敏な動きや登る動きを習得しなければなりません。 レベルは11章に分けられ、各章には独自の危険があります。吊り下げられた立方体、ゴブリンと頭蓋骨、スライド式と回転式のプラットフォーム、フリーアクセスフロア、大砲、木枠です。

チームワークモードでは次のレベルのロックを解除するためにポータル（出口）に到達するために協力する必要があります。 60の挑戦的なレベルがあなたの2人が探検するのを待っています。

インディーゲーム、スライド、ジャンプ、スイング、グラブ、ハードゲーム、正確なゲーム、ピクセルアート、手作りレベル、マルチプレイヤー、楽しい

特徴：
アクロバティックなスキルの限界をテストするための手作りの障害物コース
タイトで正確かつシンプルなコントロール：3つのボタンとジョイスティック
220以上のシングルプレイヤーレベルが11のチャプターに分割され、それぞれに独自の危険があります。
持久力、柔軟性、そして卓越した正確な動きを必要とする60のマルチプレイヤーレベル
カスタマイズ可能なキャラクターヒーロー：ブラムはブラッツドールとG.I.ジョーの私生児である。
魅力的な音楽

DOG'S DONUTS 是一款基於物理的益智遊戲，您可以在其中控制一台發射甜甜圈的機器。 做出正確的調整，找到更好的方式來餵養這只可愛的哈士奇。

使用鏟子、無人機、跳板和許多其他瘋狂的機器餵小狗。 在這個具有挑戰性的益智遊戲中，您可以通過多種不同的方式完成關卡，創造出多樣化的遊戲玩法。

充分利用遊戲物理特性，不要讓狗等甜甜圈等太久。

遊戲特色
- 專為物理謎題愛好者設計；
- 40 個手工製作的關卡待解決；
- 易於學習，簡單直觀的控制

由 Robotizar Games 開發並由 QUByte Interactive 發行
在 悠信・穆倫 的薩滿世界中探索充滿陷阱的競技場，釋放元素之力。

認識伊恩——這位11歲的夢想家，憑藉想像力讓房間充滿生機。《Minima》邀您透過光影、聲響與探索，體驗一段互動故事。

探索童年記憶的世界，透過伊恩的望遠鏡凝望，窺探他發光的帳篷，發掘日常事物中隱藏的純粹魔法。溫暖色調與手工打造的設計，將帶您透過孩童的視角，展開一段寧靜而懷舊的旅程。

特色：
• 純粹透過氛圍與探索呈現的真摯故事體驗
• 手工打造的極簡視覺，捕捉童年懷舊情懷
• 令人沉靜的配樂，引領反思與溫暖
• 探索、觀察、重溫那些充滿想像與光影的瞬間。

《Minima》不僅是遊戲，更是被賦予生命的靜謐記憶。

생산 라인을 계속 돌려라! 혼돈의 도가니에서 가장 효율적으로 컨베이어 벨트를 조합하여 공장에서 끊임없이 상품을 출하하세요! 다양한 도구와 장비를 통해 공장에서 계속 발생하는 도전과제와 상품을 처리합니다. 2인 로컬 협동 플레이가 권장되지만 싱글플레이어 역시 지원합니다. 

다양한 도구와 솔루션

여러분이 할 일은 간단합니다. 컨베이어 벨트를 다시 조합하여 공장에서 끊임없이 상품을 출하하는 거죠. 게임을 진행하면서 장애물을 극복하기 위한 온갖 종류의 도구, 장비 및 컨베이어 부품을 얻게 됩니다. 지게차, 크레인, 스프링보드 컨베이어 벨트, 포장 완충재 디스펜서 등등, 끝이 없죠! 그러니 안전모를 쓰고 머리를 굴리며 퍼즐을 해결해 보세요. 

점점 이상해지는 공장

누가 공장을 설계했는지는 모르지만 제정신인지 검사를 받아야 합니다. 산성 웅덩이에서 진공실에 옥상 틈새까지, 그냥 혼돈의 도가니가 펼쳐져 있죠. 게임을 진행하면서 점점 더 어려운 도전과제가 생겨나고 문제를 해결하기 위해 더욱더 복잡한 컨베이어 벨트를 구축하게 됩니다. 

즐거운 혼돈의 2인 로컬 협동 플레이

친구와 함께 공장 라인이 두 배로 빨리 돌게 하세요! 함께 협력하고 소통하며 미친 듯이 할 일을 떠넘기는 겁니다. 주의사항: 이 게임은 로컬 협동 플레이와 Steam Remote Play Together만 지원합니다. 온라인 멀티플레이는 지원하지 않습니다. 싱글플레이어로 진행이 가능하지만 다른 사람과 함께 2인 플레이가 권장됩니다.

단순하고 민간함 컨트롤

Ready, Steady, Ship!은 민감하지만 단순한 컨트롤을 통해 누구라도 빠르고 쉽게 즐길 수 있는 게임입니다.

The Magnificent Trufflepigs is a first-person, metal-detecting narrative game designed to be played in a single evening. You play as Adam, a sharp-witted but compassionate man returning to his childhood village of Stanning. There he'll help a woman named Beth on her mission to unearth a local treasure. As cracks begin to appear in Beth’s fairy tale plan for everything, you’ll delve into her history and discover all may not be as it seems. And you’ll have to choose how Adam responds to Beth as she faces her demons.\n\nGameplay combines laid-back metal detecting and exploration with a strong interpersonal narrative, all set in a beautiful English countryside. The Magnificent Trufflepigs is a game about trying to find something, and the tone it sets is like a typical English summer: mostly pleasant, but with stormy moments that threaten to ruin everything.

Back to Bed is an artistic 3D puzzle game with a surreal twist. Bob is an unlucky narcoleptic who has a tendency of falling asleep in his boring office and then proceeding to sleepwalk into the dangers of the big city. Luckily, Bob has a subconscious guardian named Subob, who protects the sleepwalker and guides him back to the safety of his bed.

The ever-vigilant Subob must lead Bob on a journey through a series of surreal painting-like cityscapes, where the boundary between Bob's dreams and reality have vanished.

- Unique surreal and artistic game
Play in a piece of art set in a digital frame, that mixes elements from the real world and the world of dreams to create something unique and surreal.

- Mind-bending Isometric Levels
Navigate detailed 3D puzzles that defy the laws of physics, wherein the player must manipulate the strange environment to create a safe path for Bob and avoid the dangers of the puzzle. 

- Two Characters As One
Play as the embodied subconsciousness, in the form of a small guardian creature, trying to save its own sleepwalking body from dangers of the dream world.

Get off the sofa and onto the winner's podium - participate in the action-packed summer games! Competitions in swimming, shooting, light and heavy athletics are on the agenda. Demonstrate team spirit and push yourself to peak sporting performance!

• 5 cups with increasing levels of difficulty
• 14 diverse disciplines
• Single and local multiplayer mode for up to 4 players

14 exciting sport disciplines:
• Swimming (freestyle and freestyle relay)
• Running (100-meter race, 400-meter hurdles, 800-meter race, relay race)
• Javelin
• Hammer throw
• Shot put
• Archery
• Long jump
• High jump
• Pole vault
• Weightlifting

扮演十二位主機擬人戰士中的一員，與朋友…或敵人展開對戰！

對決震擊 (Duel Shock)
將對手的生命值耗盡！生命值為零即獲勝！

爆裂導火索 (Short Fuse)
五回合對決，五次先手機會！贏得最多回合的玩家獲勝！

搶金大戰 (Cash Grab)
收集儘可能多的金幣，或從對手口袋裡電走它們，但要注意時間限制！

或者，挑戰八種單人關卡。這些小遊戲拓展了主機擬人世界觀，讓你鍛鍊技能。
想要更高難度？「超級挑戰」將在原有八個挑戰的基礎上提升至更高難度！

危険な宇宙契約があるとき、他の誰も喜んで引き受けません...彼らはあなたを呼びます。

あなたはエッジクラッシャーと呼ばれる古い準軍組織の宇宙戦闘機を操縦し、遠くの惑星、エイリアンの海の奥深く、遠くの銀河にいることに気づきます。

ニューテラ（NEWTERRA®）は、大胆な救助作戦、古代のエイリアンのアーティファクトの抽出、遠方の月の小惑星の回避、深宇宙のアンテナの修理、戦争の撤廃など、危険な任務を遂行し、各レベルの新しい世界を探るアクション戦略ゲームです。犯罪者、小惑星の嵐の間に氷を運ぶ、砂虫、敵の船、砲塔、巨大なレーザー、そしてステルス惑星駆逐艦と戦います。

この船では燃料が長持ちせず、手に入れるのが難しいです。

資源を節約し、速く行動しなければ、あなたは生き延びることはできません。

あなたは船長になる準備ができていますか？

ゲームの特徴：
-多方向重力/物理ベースのスペースシューター
-18のユニークで非常に挑戦的なミッション
-真っ暗モード（ヘッドライトだけで完全な暗闇の中でゲームをリプレイし、合計26のユニークなレベルを作成します！）
-ロン・ワッサーマンによる印象的でオリジナルのゲームサウンドトラック（パワーレンジャー、ドラゴンボールZ、X-メンなど）
-ビジュアルを備えた統合スタンドアロン音楽プレーヤー
-詳細なトレーニングミッション
-可変難易度設定
-多言語サポート

Fun and Quirky shoot-em-up game.

The object of the game is to shoot the chickens using an array of different weaponry, from pistols, to AK47, RPG’s to Alien Ray Guns! Gameplay is set over a field twice as wide as the screen, so you must be constantly moving your aim side to side in order to reach the whole game field.

To increase the difficulty, the chickens throw eggs at the screen to obscure the player’s field of view. Once your screen is covered….GAME OVER!

During each level, ammo crates drop at varying intervals which will refresh your ammo levels and “Shino”.

Carry up to 3 weapons with you; only 4 are available in the earlier levels, the remaining weapons will unlock as you progress through the levels.

The game contains 15 different levels. Each level introduces different baddie chickens with varying difficulties to kill them due to enhanced protection gear. Chicken types include Riot Police Chickens, Tank Chickens, Ninja Chickens, Helicopter Chickens and many more!

橄欖球在手掌中的所有興奮！
通過休閒控制系統，享受發毛的混亂和戲劇性的轉換！
整個田野都在一個學校桌上等待！
通過個人球員的優勢自定義您的球隊，並帶領他們取得勝利！

【練習遊戲】
輕鬆播放單人比賽！
七個或15個側面！
在此處或通過教程中獲取規則！

【比賽】
參加國家和國際七人賽錦標賽！
特殊競爭對手正在等待國際隊！
盡力成為新世界冠軍！

【友好遊戲】
與多達4名球員一起玩合作社和PVP比賽！
與快速思考的NPC一起工作或相互測試！
在一個獨一無二的領域上玩，可以保證在任何人身上帶出橄欖球迷！
膠囊踢
使用您的積分獲取新物品！
通過一系列可獲得的製服和加電項目來磨練您的團隊技能！

【迷你遊戲】
嘗試迴避！
快速駛過即將來臨的對手，從嘗試中獲得最大的積分！

【團隊選擇】
它不會停止使用制服和動力！即使是每個玩家的單個樣式也可以自定義！
組建一支不可忽視的明星團隊！

Forge your Viking legacy in Viking City Tycoon, a strategic city-building game that challenges you to lead a Norse settlement to greatness. From humble beginnings, you’ll grow your village into a sprawling Viking stronghold, balancing resource management, trade, and conquest in the unforgiving world of the North.

Take charge as the chief of your village and:
- Build legendary Norse structures, longhouses and majestic feasting halls
- Carefully manage vital resources like wood, iron, and food to ensure your people thrive
- Train an army of fearless Viking warriors, ready to set sail and raid distant lands
- Defend your settlement from rival clans and mythical creatures lurking in the shadows
- Engage in trade to acquire rare goods and powerful technologies
- Expand your empire by founding new outposts and extending your influence across the region

As you lead, you’ll face the harsh realities of Viking life—deciding whether to cultivate a thriving trade network or create a feared society of battle-hardened raiders. Every decision shapes the future of your village.

Will you create a peaceful trading hub, or lead your Viking warriors to become the fiercest conquerors the world has ever seen? The choices you make will shape the future of your empire.

This game transports you to a low-poly environment where castles, tough soldiers, battle-hardened knights and loyal bishops are the true stars. Use your best strategies to open a path and conquer the castle of your opponent’s king!

Game features:

• 3D environment and boards.
• Animated 3D pieces.
• Face off against the advanced AI. Choose from 9 possible difficulty levels.
• Play face-to-face with your friends or family.
• Record games.
• Switch between a 3D view and the classic 2D view.
• Move pieces using the Joy-Con™ or touch screen.
• Day or night environment scenario selection.
• Option to use an openings book for the AI.

Backworlds is a multi-dimensional puzzle platform game in which you explore by painting. Move between two parallel worlds, each with its own unique set of properties, using your brush to flow seamlessly from one to the other. Solve environmental conundrums by using each world’s physical properties to your advantage, and use your own creativity to craft original solutions to the game’s puzzles.

Features
• Unique painting puzzle mechanic - let creativity flow in your solutions
• Non-linear - choose your own path to explore and play
• 4 distinct worlds - each with their own atmosphere and mechanics
• Boss levels and secrets
• Beautiful soundtrack by BAFTA nominated composer David Housden
• Unleash your creativity with new touch screen support
• Control your brush with the built-in gyroscope

The faith of the forest is threatened by evil forces. Your new form comes with new abilities. It's up to you to break this spell and save the forest, maybe you'll even get your humanity back!

"Smashroom" is an indie platform-adventure.
The main character is a small mushroom with the ability to explode at will, making his way through the levels of the game.
The explosive-skill can also be used as a "mid-air jump" and part of the level design revolves around this characteristic.
Another important feature is the simple "level-up" system the player can use to improve specific skills, such as the attack rate, the defense, and the special elemental damage. New skill-levels can be reached by collecting points that are obtained from enemies, boxes and destructible rocks.

In the short story "Deep Beyond," dive into a world of mystery and adventure alongside Lilly as she embarks on her quest. Explore ancient wrecks, solve intricate puzzles, and uncover the secrets of her past as you journey through the depths of the ocean. 

FEATURES:

- Dive deep into an underwater adventure.

- Immerse yourself in fully-voiced characters.

- Solve challenging puzzles to uncover the secrets.

- Take Chester on every step of your journey.

- Enjoy stunning visuals with vibrant colors.
